redraw.body: Photograph of a 17th-century buccaneer fighting with a sword, seen from the side facing left, his face in profile turned to the left, his bare head and face uncovered: a lean young man with long brown hair, a loose white linen shirt with full sleeves, a red sash at the waist, dark brown breeches and tall black boots; his empty left hand open, no second weapon, no mask, no helmet. Plain flat grey-blue background. Historical reenactment photography, sharp focus, realistic.
